A secretive order, they welcome visitors but do not share much in the way of information.}} The [[Chantry of Secrets]] is a place of worship dedicated to the gods of Tyria. It is also the hidden headquarters of the [[Order of Whispers]] from which they plan and launch operations to safeguard the future of Elona. This area functions as a lobby for organizing parties and includes convenient access portals to [[Elite Mission]]s. ==Getting there== The [[primary quest]] [[Rally The Princes]] will lead characters here. This outpost is located due west from [[Wehhan Terraces]]. Follow along the southern path and across a bridge. ==Exits== *[[The Fissure of Woe]] ([[Emote|kneel]] to the statue of [[Balthazar]] and speak to the [[Champion of Balthazar]]) *[[The Underworld]]
